plan.title: Event moves to History after PO creation

steps.note: Select an existing event with bids suitable for awarding.
Open the buyer's events list before selecting the existing event.
Verify the events list and its controls rendered successfully.
Confirm that the Live list contains at least one event before awarding.
Ensure the selected event is closed so awarding is available.
Award the closed event to an eligible bidder and submit the proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award so purchase-order creation can proceed.
Complete approval and create the purchase order(s).
Verify that the created purchase order carries the awarded event line items.
Return to the events list after PO creation.
Verify the events list rendered after the state transition.
Inspect the Live tab after PO creation; the exact selected event's absence cannot be asserted without its title.
Open History to locate the transitioned event.
Assert that the selected event is listed in History.
Verify that the historical event shows its awarded status.
